name: Brass Internal Wheel Hub Counterweights for 1.9/2.2 Inch Rims
fits: Axial SCX10, Traxxas TRX4, TRX6, 1/10 RC Crawlers, 1.9/2.2 inch VP style wheels
desc: These brass internal counterweights are designed for 1.9 and 2.2-inch beadlock wheel rims to add weight low on the chassis. They help lower the center of gravity and improve stability and traction while climbing steep terrain. The weights are CNC machined from high-quality brass and typically fit 6-hole style wheel hubs.
